zh.title: 捷克研議向烏克蘭供應最多16架L-39 Skyfox
zh.summary: 捷克研議向烏克蘭供應最多16架L-39 Skyfox，追加12架僅獲初步確認。
body: 捷克可能向烏克蘭供應最多16架 Aero Vodochody L-39 Skyfox。捷克第一副總理兼工業貿易部長 Karel Havlíček 於2026年11月11日在基輔向記者表示，四架此前已獲確認；他並與烏克蘭總理 Sergii Koretskyi 討論再供應12架。
據 Czech News Agency（ČTK）報導，會談取得額外飛機可供應的「初步確認」；交付時程尚未公佈。
Aero目前每年生產約12架Skyfox。

en.title: Czechia weighs supplying Ukraine with up to 16 L-39 Skyfox jets
en.summary: Czechia considers supplying Ukraine up to 16 L-39 Skyfox jets; talks on 12 additional jets yielded preliminary confirmation.
body: Czechia could supply Ukraine with up to 16 Aero Vodochody L-39 Skyfox jets, First Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Industry and Trade Karel Havlíček told reporters in Kyiv on November 11, 2026. He said four aircraft had previously been confirmed and that he had discussed supplying another 12 with Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi.
According to the Czech News Agency (ČTK), the talks produced a “preliminary confirmation” that additional aircraft could be supplied. No delivery schedule has been announced.
Aero currently produces approximately 12 Skyfox jets per year.

zh.title: 阿聯酋航空將取得六架空中巴士A380-800
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空將取得六架空中巴士A380-800；其中兩架已完成出售
body: 阿聯酋航空將取得六架空中巴士A380-800；這些飛機目前由該航空公司以租賃方式營運，並列入其機隊，租賃協議的另一方為卡達的Lesha Bank。Lesha Bank於2026年11月10日確認，已達成向阿聯酋航空出售六架飛機的協議。
六架A380是透過Amedeo Air Four Plus租予阿聯酋航空；Lesha Bank於2026年6月收購Amedeo Air Four Plus。
六架中有兩架已完成出售；其餘四架預計在各自租約到期時分階段完成交易，整體時程延續至2028年4月。

en.title: Emirates to Take Ownership of Six Airbus A380-800s
en.summary: Emirates will take ownership of six Airbus A380-800s; two sales are complete.
body: Emirates will take ownership of six Airbus A380-800 aircraft that it currently operates as part of its fleet under a lease agreement with Qatar’s Lesha Bank. Lesha Bank confirmed on November 10, 2026, that it had reached an agreement to sell the six aircraft to Emirates; two of the six sales have already been completed.
The six aircraft were leased to Emirates through Amedeo Air Four Plus, which Lesha Bank acquired in June 2026.
The sale of the remaining four aircraft is due to be concluded in stages through April 2028 as their respective leases conclude.

zh.title: 聯合航空宣佈限制未授權第三方 AI 代理存取訂位平臺
zh.summary: 聯合航空宣佈限制未授權第三方 AI 代理存取訂位平臺，並將更新運輸條款。
body: 聯合航空於2026年11月11日宣佈，限制未經授權的第三方人工智慧（AI）代理存取其數位訂位平臺。
該航空公司表示，AI 代理可能暴露乘客敏感資料；其操作也可能造成非預期購買，或導致客戶帳戶（包括 MileagePlus 忠誠計畫帳戶）出現不希望的變更。
聯合航空也對可能違反 Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) 與 Department of Transportation (DOT) 安全規定表示關切。
這項限制也涵蓋透過線上旅行社與彙整平臺等間接管道使用第三方 AI 代理的情況。
聯合航空表示，將更新運輸條款以反映這項決定。

en.title: United Airlines Restricts Booking-Platform Access for Unauthorized Third-Party AI Agents
en.summary: United Airlines restricts booking-platform access for unauthorized third-party AI agents and will update its carriage terms.
body: United Airlines announced on November 11, 2026, that it is restricting unauthorized third-party artificial intelligence (AI) agents from accessing its digital booking platform.

The airline said AI agents could expose sensitive passenger information and take actions that could result in unintended purchases or unwanted changes to customer accounts, including its MileagePlus loyalty program.
United also expressed concern about a potential violation of Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and Department of Transportation (DOT) security regulations.
The restriction also extends to third-party AI agents used through indirect channels such as online travel agents and aggregators.
United said it will update its conditions of carriage to reflect the decision.

zh.title: Magnifica Air訂購10架空中巴士A220-300 ACJ飛機
zh.summary: Magnifica Air訂購10架A220 ACJ，未來機隊將增至17架。
body: AeroTime報導，Magnifica Air訂購10架空中巴士A220-300 ACJ飛機。這筆確定訂單將使Magnifica Air未來機隊增至17架。
Aerospace Global News報導，Magnifica Air計畫以這些飛機提供高端定期航班服務，搭配低密度客艙及私人航空服務元素，包括專用航廈、地面接送和禮賓服務。
AeroTime另報導，Magnifica Air選用空中巴士的Skywise數位資料平臺，支援飛行規劃功能。Aerospace Global News指出，空中巴士與Magnifica尚未公佈這10架飛機的交付時程，也未說明它們預計何時投入服務。

en.title: Magnifica Air orders 10 Airbus A220-300 ACJ aircraft
en.summary: Magnifica Air orders 10 A220 ACJ jets, expanding its future fleet to 17 aircraft.
body: AeroTime reported that Magnifica Air disclosed an order for 10 Airbus A220-300 ACJ aircraft. The firm order takes the airline’s future fleet to 17 aircraft.

Aerospace Global News reported that Magnifica Air intends to use the jets for scheduled premium services, with low-density cabins and elements of private aviation, including dedicated terminals, ground transfers and concierge assistance.

AeroTime also reported that Magnifica Air selected Airbus’ Skywise as its digital data platform, with flight planning among the functions it is intended to power. Aerospace Global News reported that Airbus and Magnifica have not announced a delivery timetable for the 10 aircraft or when they are expected to enter service.
